title: Player pinned to zero velocity on stairs in Map3
explanation: At frame 2130, the player lands on Map3 stairs at coordinates (5458, 560), setting is_stair_stuck in Player.gd:L150. Frame 2140 jump and frame 2142 right inputs produce zero velocity because Player.gd:L165 forces velocity to Vector2.ZERO until 3 rapid left inputs occur, violating the kinematics invariant.
